title: Lecturer on Oral Medicine, Infection, and Immunity
bio: Dr. Giuseppe Cicero is a specialist in periodontology and implant dentistry. He earned his dental degree, cum laude , from the University of Rome Tor Vergata and completed advanced training in oral surgery at the University of Valencia in Spain. He then completed a three-year postgraduate residency in periodontology and implant dentistry at New York University. Cicero’s academic work focuses on bone regeneration, including the development of innovative protocols in soft and hard tissue regeneration and the use of 3D printing in guided bone regeneration. He has authored publications on periodontal tissue grafting, oral pathology, and stem cell research, as well as a book on dental pulp stem cells. He lectures internationally on these topics. He maintains private practices in Italy and the United States, where his clinical work is limited to periodontology and implant dentistry.
